title: Using a Yellow Underpainting
content: Starting with a yellow underpainting puts "fire in the belly" of a gray painting.The yellow layer is made up of a thin layer of casein brushed on in advance of the plein-air session.The underpainting gets mostly covered up by opaque or semi-opaque paint, but it manages to peek through in a few places.ThisYouTube excerptis from my newGumroad tutorial "TRIADS"Art MaterialsRicheson caseinYellow ochre gouachePrussian blue gouacheLight red gouacheTitanium white gouacheWatercolor sketchbookTravel brush setWater cupHomemade easelTripodWater-soluble colored pencils set
